notes.title: Sheriff exam mode is finally here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425259/c0f1396b10cf58daf6d7d7462e72d493662c7c06.jpg[/img]

Features
[list]
[*] Added exam mode with 5 new games

[olist]
[*] Bottles up
[*] Nightmare
[*] Mines
[*] Robbery
[*]  Duel
[/olist]
[*] Added exam Town and environment
[*] More Sheriff voiceovers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425259/2606d1e5d50309c954b6c3ce43cd0ca24c605ce6.jpg[/img]

Improvements
[list]
[*] Improved FPS vastly
[*] Added explanations for each minigame for easier understanding
[*] Modified weapons
[*] Improved Sheriff animations
[*] Added colored trail on cans for flying cans minigame
[*] Added bullet trail for better user experience
[*] User Interface buttons highlighted when aimed at
[*] Shotgun has a cooldown on reload but is more powerful
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425259/aa5558495d8e529e79b964928e3b0d12ea1a8860.jpg[/img]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed left-handed User Interface interaction
[*] Fixed mission scoring not being saved bug
[*] Fixed unresponsive User Interface bugs
[*] Tutorial screen changed to controls and now works properly
[*] Tested for Vive, Cosmos, and Rift
[/list]
